description: We don’t gatekeep around here✨ my tried and true no spread sugar cookie recipe!! I’m going live for the first time tomorrow at 12:00pm to decorate these with you guys!🤭👏🏼 @KitchenAid   #royalicingcookies #customsugarcookies #cottagebaker #cookies #cookier #cookierecipe
transcript: Today I'm going to be giving you guys my no-spread sugar cookie recipe that I use for my small in-home business. I make custom royal icing sugar cookies and today I'm going to show you exactly how I do it. The other day I made a video asking if anybody would be interested in me making cookie content or going live and answering questions about royal icing and cookies in general. And I got so much love you guys. Seriously, thank you for all of my new followers and all of the support I cannot thank you enough. So we're going to get straight into this recipe because the first thing you're going to need to be a cookie baddie is a good cookie recipe. So let's get to it. First we're going to cream together one cup of softened unsalted butter and scrape down the sides of our bowl. Next we're going to add in one cup sugar and mix until nice and fluffy. We're going to scrape down the sides and add in one cold egg, a teaspoon of salt, and two teaspoons of vanilla extract. That was kind of heavy. It's okay, these aren't for anybody else. And two teaspoons of almond extract and I get both of these off of Amazon. Then I'm just going to mix that until everything's nice and incorporated before adding in my three cups of all-purpose flour. This was a single batch, so I did the first two cups at once and mixed that, scraped down the sides before adding in my third cup. And then I'm going to mix that one more time and wait for everything to clump into a ball and pull away from the bowl like you're seeing here. That's how you know everything's ready to go. And I'm just going to scrape down the paddles and get that into a ball and plop that down onto some parchment paper. And then I'm going to take my rolling pin with these thickness rings and I roll all of my dough out to three eighths of an inch or 10 millimeters. And I'm just trying my best here to keep the dough within a square shape just so it makes it easier when we go to transfer that onto some saran wrap and chill in the fridge for about 30 minutes to an hour or just so it's cold enough that you can use it and it's not super floppy dough. I'm just going to preheat your oven to 375 and get ready to cut out your cookies. Here I'm just using a silicone rolling mat and just cutting out my cookies like normal and laying those on my baking sheet. I use a silicone baking mat but you can use parchment paper. I just like it because it gets a really even bake. And then I'm going to take my cookie scribe and I'm going to poke holes in every cookie just so they bake evenly and I'm going to put those in the oven for 10 minutes. As soon as those come out of the oven I like to take a flat spatula and run that over the top of every cookie just so they're nice and level. And that's just another prevention of icing every spilling off the edge. And there you have it. A perfect no spread sugar cookie every single time. I hope you guys love this recipe as much as I do because it has never filled me.
